Defensive sector with strong 30d relative outperformance (+4.14%), low beta 0.35, benefits from rotation amid rising rates and tech weakness.
Strong recent momentum (+5.49% 30d, +4.23% vs SPY), Q2 bank earnings July 14-17 as near-term catalyst, benefits from higher yields.
Defensive tilt with near-zero beta, positive relative performance; hedges against tech-led drawdown and geopolitical volatility.
Cash-like ballast amid rising 10yr yields (4.61%), sticky inflation (core 2.9%), and unresolved Hormuz shock; preserves capital with positive carry.

portfolio_rationale: Given rising yields, sticky inflation, weak tech/semis momentum, and an active Strait of Hormuz oil catalyst, I tilt defensive with energy upside and rate-beneficiary financials while trimming market beta.
rationale_summary: Defensive rotation into energy, healthcare, financials, low-vol equity plus short-duration Treasuries to capture geopolitical/oil upside while limiting exposure to the fading tech/growth leadership.
